items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: I met this man once later. He says, I am, uh, availing myself of my last opportunity to hear your beautiful music.

ctx.x: I've seen his, I've seen his name. Uh-huh, Bode Mala.

Well, anyway, he was taking organ lessons from him. So, he said to me, if you will, he says, the coming thing in pictures is the organ. So, he says, if you'll get your organ to practice on, I'll teach you what Bode Mala teaches me. So, he got a book and gave it to me and I was, uh, going to the Christian church. That was my, really, home church, church I was, uh, raised in, up on St. Charles Avenue. And they said I could use the organ if they had a practice on. So, that's what I did. And pretty soon I got a job…
I know the name again. Geringer, all right.
